title: Fix internal admin losing SUPER during customized plan provisioning
summary: Internal tenant administrators no longer lose SUPER permission set when their customized plan configuration omits it during first-time provisioning, preventing accidental lockout.
key_points: Added IsUserInternalAdmin helper to check Global Admin, Dynamics 365 Admin, and BC Admin plans
Applied internal-admin exemption to customized plan branch where it was previously bypassed
Delegated admins intentionally excluded from exemption as their SUPER is governed separately
Added six comprehensive tests covering various admin and user scenarios with customized plans
Default plan behavior and existing users remain unaffected
